verdict: The bonded GYROID is strain-controlled, so its figure of merit is σ_e/E_s, not σ_e (relative to Ti-6Al-4V: Ti-6Al-4V 1.00, Ti-6Al-7Nb 1.03, CP-Ti-Gr4 0.58, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 1.41, Ta 0.23, Ti-15Zr 1.19). An energy LOWER bound — it can show a ligament binding, never safe — puts the ligaments' RMS stress at ≥ 0.47 E_s·ε on both FE readings (axial 0.0805 ⊥ radial 0.0811 of E_s), neither of which is the in-plane traction modulus the bound needs. On the lower reading (the axial one), at t_L = k_p = 1 with near-uniaxial ligaments, the bound alone reaches SF 2 above a stem surface strain of Ti-6Al-4V 1678, Ti-6Al-7Nb 1731, CP-Ti-Gr4 968, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 2360, Ta 389, Ti-15Zr 1993 µε on a large stem; k_p > 1 lowers these, t_L < 1 (not excluded) raises them. The source tree's upper surface strain (1837 µε, one tree, one gust), placed on a large stem, exceeds them for CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta, Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb on the lower reading (CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta, Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb on the higher; any stress state: Ta); its median for Ta. The gyroid⊥shank junction is a candidate the bound cannot see: at t_L = 1 its first layer absorbs 7.4 µm of radial mismatch, 2.75× the wood's strain over one rim period. The anode's bond force in the mature state is 746 N on a stiff bond and 103 N on a soft one (1654 N with a rigid sleeve at `103`'s stiff bond): the Zone 1 shank carries 7.9 MPa, and the tie reverses the force onto the barbs' easy flank — which 01_01 §4.3 A says nothing loads in service. The FLANGE DISC in state 2 on a rigid bark (673 N, Zone-3 fit) carries a worst nominal 97.1 MPa (disc_shank_root|b_pull_at_shank|rim_only_dished_seat): one-sided (a bearing without preload) it reaches SF 2 at K_f 1.51 on the printed route ⊥ 2.58 on the CNC route — the same number is its un-notched SF when a preload ≥ F carries both halves. On the air-dry bark reading the force is 66 N; the mature-state disc force is not bounded. The mass path stays below 0.33 MPa. Not computed: E_z* and k_p (the infinite lattice's come from `fea --periodic`, not read here; the finite part's — no traction case), the junction (a junction model), t_L (`106` — conditional), the count of host-stem cycles above the threshold (the field sensor), any K_t, a barb row's ratchet force, the static means, ice, the collar and lug root.
